title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with Symboli Rudolf…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Look there, Trainer. Do you see that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She points towards a claw machine. The prizes seem to be plushies shaped like Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What a marvelous variety of designs. Rather charming, wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: They would look perfect in the student council office… Hmmm, what to do…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf falls silent as she stares at the plushies.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm rather unused to these amusement centers. Truth be told, I've never played a claw machine before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Part of leading is choosing the right person for the job. I would be a fool to refuse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I eagerly await your success, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
